title: Can ride
prompt: You can ride the roller coaster if you are at least 120 cm tall OR you are with an adult. Return true if the person can ride.
signature: func solve(height_cm: int, with_adult: bool) -> bool:
starter:
func solve(height_cm: int, with_adult: bool) -> bool:

hint: `or` is true if either side is true: `height_cm >= 120 or with_adult`.
solution:
func solve(height_cm: int, with_adult: bool) -> bool:
